RadioTower2FSuperNerdText:
You can listen to
the radio any- where. Tune in!
RadioTower2FTeacherText:
Lullabies on the
radio may make #MON sleep.
RadioTower2FTeacherText_Rockets:
Why would they
want to take over the RADIO TOWER?
RadioTower2FBlackBelt1Text:
Sorry. Authorized
personnel only beyond this point.

It wasn't that way
before.

There's something
wrong with the DIRECTOR…
RadioTower2FBlackBelt2Text:
Feel free to look
around anywhere.

The DIRECTOR is
nice again, just as he was before.
GruntM4SeenText:
Three years ago,
TEAM ROCKET was forced to disband.

But we're making a
comeback here!
GruntM4AfterBattleText:
We won't let you
ruin our plans for our comeback!
GruntM5SeenText:
We're TEAM ROCKET,
the exploiters of #MON!

We love being
evil! Scared?
GruntM5AfterBattleText:
We're not always
evil. We just do whatever we like.
GruntM6SeenText:
Hey, hey! Keep out
of our way!
GruntM6AfterBattleText:
Our EXECUTIVES are
trying to take this place over.

They have some big
plan. I wonder what that is?
GruntF2SeenText:
Hahaha!

How boring.
It was far too

easy to take over
this place!

Come on, keep me
amused!
GruntF2AfterBattleText:
You beat me, and
I won't forget it!
RadioTower2FBuenaShowIntroductionText:
BUENA: Hi! I'm
BUENA!

Do you know about
a radio program called PASSWORD?

If you can tell me
the password from

the program, you
will earn points.

Save up those
points and trade

them to that sweet
young lady over

there for some
choice prizes!

Here you go!

It's your very own
point card!
RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInToMyShowText:
BUENA: Tune in to
my PASSWORD SHOW!
RadioTower2FBuenaDoYouKnowPasswordText:
BUENA: Hi!
Did you tune in to my radio show?

Do you remember
today's password?
RadioTower2FBuenaJoinTheShowText:
BUENA: Oh, wow!
Thank you!

What was your name
again?

…, OK!

Come on, .
Join the show.
RadioTower2FBuenaEveryoneSayPasswordText:
BUENA: Everyone
ready?

I want to hear you
shout out today's

password for
!
RadioTower2FBuenaComeBackAfterListeningT:
BUENA: Come back
after you listen

to my show, OK?
Catch ya later!
RadioTower2FBuenaAlreadyPlayedText:
BUENA: Sorry…

You get just one
chance each day.

Come back tomorrow
for another try!
RadioTower2FBuenaCorrectAnswerText:
BUENA: YIPPEE!
That's right!

You did tune in!
I'm so happy!

You earned one
point! Congrats!
RadioTower2FBuenaDidYouForgetText:
BUENA: Aww…
That's not it…

Did you forget the
password?
RadioTower2FBuenaThanksForComingText:
BUENA: Yup! Our
contestant was

.
Thanks for coming!

I hope all you
listeners will

come too!
I'll be waiting!
RadioTower2FBuenaPasswordIsHelpText:
BUENA: Huh?
Today's password?

HELP, of course!
RadioTower2FBuenaCardIsFullText:
BUENA: Your BLUE
CARD's full.

Trade it in for a
fabulous prize!
RadioTower2FBuenaTuneInAfterSixText:
BUENA: Tune in to
PASSWORD every

night from six to
midnight!

Tune in, then drop
in for a visit!
RadioTower2FBuenaNoBlueCardText:
BUENA: Oh? You
forgot to bring your BLUE CARD?

I can't give you
points if you don't have it.
RadioTower2FBuenaOfferPhoneNumberText:
BUENA: Oh! Your
BLUE CARD reached

{d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points today!
That's so wild!

Hmm… There isn't a
prize for hitting {d:BLUE_CARD_POINT_CAP} points, but…

You came by so
often, .

I'll make you a
special deal!

How would you like
my phone number?
RadioTower2FBuenaOfferNumberAgainText:
BUENA: ,
do you want to

register my phone
number?
RadioTower2FBuenaCallMeText:
BUENA: I look
forward to hearing from you!
RadioTower2FBuenaSadRejectedText:
BUENA: Aww… It's a
special prize…
RadioTower2FBuenaYourPhoneIsFullText:
BUENA: ,
your phone list

has no room left
for me…
RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistPointsForPr:
You can cash in
your saved points

for a lovely prize
of your choice!
RadioTower2FBuenaReceptionistNoCardText:
You can't trade in
points without your BLUE CARD.

Don't forget your
BLUE CARD!
